description: Polymarket price history of one market outcome from the CLOB: time and price points over the last hour, 6 hours, day, week, month or all time, with first, last, change, high and low. Give the market slug and outcome, or a CLOB token id. Use to chart how the odds moved, spot a swing after news, or backtest a signal. Example: slug=will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-republican-presidential-nomination. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

outcome.description: Outcome name, e.g. Yes or No (default the first outcome)

slug.description: The market's Polymarket slug (from polymarket_markets) or its polymarket.com URL

token_id.description: Instead of slug: the CLOB token id of one outcome

name: polymarket_price_history
title: Polymarket price history
